title: Original-section extensionality for restricted balanced sheaf tensors
statement: Let $Z,R,B,\alpha,M,N,H,E,p_B,\eta$ have the meanings of the module-sheaf and tensor constructions [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]: $Z$ is a topological space, $\alpha:R\to B$ is a unital map of commutative ring sheaves, $M$ is a $B$-module sheaf, $N,H$ are $R$-module sheaves, and $E$ is the sheafification of $U\mapsto B(U)\otimes_{R(U)}N(U)$. If $f,g:\operatorname{Res}_{\alpha}(M\otimes_B E)\to H$ are $R$-linear sheaf morphisms agreeing on $p_B(m,\eta(b\otimes n))$ for every open $U$ and sections $m\in M(U)$, $b\in B(U)$, $n\in N(U)$, then $f=g$. The maps need not be $B$-linear. No flatness or nonzero assumptions are imposed.

source.place: Tag 08DE, proof, ordinary balanced identity; Tag 0GMW, tensor and sheafification. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08DE and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0GMW.

proof.text: The extension presheaf unit is inverted by sheafification, by the module sheafification adjunction with fully faithful right adjoint. W_whiskerLeft makes its tensor with M.val inverted as well. Compose the sheafified tensor map with tensorObjIsoSheafification.inv and restrict scalars to obtain an isomorphism q onto the source of f and g.

Cancel q, then use faithfulness of the functor to abelian sheaves and injectivity of the abelian-sheafification adjunction to test the maps on original presheaf sections. Restriction of scalars changes no underlying abelian presheaf.

Induct on the outer B-tensor and inner R-tensor. Zero and sums use additivity; naturality of the module sheafification unit reduces a pure double tensor m tensor (b tensor n) to the assumed original-section equality.

theorem balancedTensor_originalSections_hom_ext (α : R ⟶ B)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B)) (N : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 R))
    {H : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 R)}
    {f g : (restrictScalars (𝓻 α)).obj
        ((monoidalCategory B).tensorObj M (changeOfRings.{u, u, u} α N)) ⟶ H}
    (h : ∀ (W : (Opens Z)ᵒᵖ) (m : M.val.obj W)
      (b : B.obj.obj W) (n : N.val.obj W),
      f.val.app W
        ((tensorObjIsoSheafification M (changeOfRings.{u, u, u} α N)).inv.val.app W
        (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 B).obj)).unit.app
          (M.val ⊗ (changeOfRings.{u, u, u} α N).val)).app W
            (m ⊗ₜ[B.obj.obj W]
              ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 B).obj)).unit.app
                (changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} α N)).app W
                  (b ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj W,(α.hom.app W).hom] n)))) =
      g.val.app W
        ((tensorObjIsoSheafification M (changeOfRings.{u, u, u} α N)).inv.val.app W
        (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 B).obj)).unit.app
          (M.val ⊗ (changeOfRings.{u, u, u} α N).val)).app W
            (m ⊗ₜ[B.obj.obj W]
              ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 B).obj)).unit.app
                (changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} α N)).app W
                  (b ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj W,(α.hom.app W).hom] n))))) :
    f = g
